item.title: RAG in Production, Part 1: Why Observability Matters Before Anything Breaks
item.description: Building a RAG pipeline is the easy part. This is Part 1 of a two-part series on how I instrumented my personal assistant's Vault for production - covering the four observability layers, span tracing, and the pipeline metrics that tell us whether our system is actually working.

item.title: RAG in Production: What Breaks, What to Measure, and How I Monitor It

item.title: RAG vs Long Context Debate
item.description: Long context windows have reopened the debate about whether Retrieval Augmented Generation is still necessary. The honest answer is: it depends on what problem is actually being solved.

item.title: Vibe Coding: Superpower for Prototyping, Liability in Production
item.description: Vibe coding lets anyone build software with plain English, but unchecked AI generation leads to security flaws, credential leaks, design drift, and threatens open-source sustainability.
